question.text: Choose the correct statement from the following :

options.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>LiF</mi></math> has least negative standard enthalpy of formation among alkali metal fluorides.
The standard enthalpy of formation for alkali metal bromides becomes less negative on descending the group.
The low solubility of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>CsI</mi></math> in water is due to its high lattice enthalpy.
Among the alkali metal halides, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>LiF</mi></math> is least soluble in water.

solution.text:
(3) CsI has less lattice enthalpy. But due to less hydration enthalpy of Cs+ion it is less soluble.
(4) LiF is least soluble in water.
